AI Meeting Assistants

Fireflies.ai

Fireflies.ai records, transcribes, summarizes and analyzes meetings while connecting conversation data to collaboration and business tools.

What is Fireflies.ai?

Fireflies.ai is an AI meeting assistant for capturing conversations and turning them into searchable transcripts, summaries and structured meeting intelligence. It works across major conferencing systems and adds team analytics, conversation intelligence and integrations as plans increase, while some advanced AI usage is governed by credits.

Best for: Teams that want meeting capture plus searchable conversation intelligence, integrations and automation across a broad collaboration stack.

Main features

  • Meeting recording and transcription
  • AI-generated summaries
  • Searchable conversation history
  • Conversation intelligence
  • Team analytics
  • Meeting-platform integrations
  • GraphQL API

Use cases

  • Automatically transcribe recurring meetings
  • Generate summaries and action items
  • Search calls for customer or project topics
  • Analyze team conversations
  • Send meeting data into CRM and workflow tools

Who is it for?

  • sales teams
  • customer-success teams
  • recruiters
  • remote teams
  • operations teams

Pricing and plans

freemium subscription with AI credits

Starting price: USD 10 / seat/month, billed annually for Pro

Check official pricing ↗

Advantages

  • Free plan includes ongoing transcription access
  • Wide conferencing and integration coverage
  • Official GraphQL API supports programmatic access

Limitations

  • The free plan has limited AI summaries, storage and AI credits
  • Advanced AI features can consume additional credits
  • Enterprise is annual-only and higher-level administration is plan-gated

Frequently asked questions

Is there a Fireflies free plan?

Yes. Fireflies lists a $0 Free tier with transcription, a limited AI-summary allowance, team storage and a monthly AI-credit allocation.

What is the entry paid price?

The current pricing page lists Pro from $10 per seat per month when billed annually, with a higher month-to-month rate.

Does Fireflies have an API?

Yes. Fireflies publishes a GraphQL API for programmatic access to supported meeting and workspace data.
